description:
About the role

Abnormal is hiring a Mid Market Manager to lead our France and Benelux Mid Market sales team, based in France.

You will own a team of Account Executives selling to mid-market customers across both regions. You will be accountable for pipeline, forecast accuracy, and quota attainment, and for building a team that wins new business and grows existing customers. You will work closely with Sales Engineering, Customer Success, RevOps, Marketing, and our channel partners, and report into EMEA Mid Market Sales leadership.

What you'll do

You will build and coach a team that creates its own pipeline and closes it with discipline.

  • Recruit, hire, and onboard a high-performing team of Account Executives across France and Benelux, on time and on budget.
  • Set clear expectations for productivity metrics and growth milestones, and coach each AE to hit them.
  • Inspect pipeline and deals rigorously. This means getting hands-on in live opportunities alongside your AEs while coaching them on qualification, multi-threading, and closing.
  • Forecast monthly and quarterly revenue to executive leadership with accuracy, using a consistent deal inspection and forecast methodology.
  • Drive pipeline generation across field sales, marketing, sales development, and channel partners to accelerate new business.
  • Build the account strategy for France and Benelux and lead collaborative team selling across the region.
  • Partner with Sales Engineering to deliver outstanding product demonstrations and a repeatable technical validation and proof-of-concept program.
  • Develop and grow relationships with existing channel partners, and identify and onboard new ones, so that partners become a real source of pipeline and deal support in both markets.
  • Work with Customer Success to deliver value realization, strong renewal rates, expansion, and customer referrals.
  • Engage and close new business at executive level (CISO, CIO, CTO) in your territory.
  • Run Quarterly Business Reviews that measure sales productivity, plan execution, and progress against strategic objectives.
  • Use AI and modern sales tooling in how you forecast, inspect pipeline, prepare coaching, and run the team, and help your AEs do the same.

What you'll bring

You are a proven sales leader who is fluent in French and English and passionate about the value Abnormal delivers to customers. You act with professionalism, honesty, and integrity.

  • Fluent French and English, written and spoken.
  • 2+ years of sales experience with a track record of exceeding quota selling security, networking, and/or software solutions.
  • 2+ years leading a sales team focused on new business and new logos.
  • A hunter mentality: direct experience managing teams responsible for creating new demand, acquiring customers, and sourcing pipeline.
  • A record of closing complex sales with multiple buying influences, including in new or emerging solution categories.
  • Experience closing deals of all sizes, from smaller transactional deals to $50K to $100K+.
  • Experience building strong relationships with customers and partners at executive level.
  • Hands-on experience coaching AEs through live deals and holding them to a disciplined forecast.
  • Experience working with channel partners to generate and close business.
  • Strong presentation and communication skills, and the ability to translate technical features into business value.
  • Comfort using AI and modern sales tooling to improve forecasting, coaching, and execution.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced environment, and a habit of holding yourself accountable to consistent over-achievement.

Nice to have

  • Dutch and/or Spanish, which helps with Benelux and wider Southern Europe coverage.
  • Experience with consultative, value-based sales methodologies such as Force Management or Challenger Sale.

A note on AI in our process: 
Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.

Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
